cards.summary: Smooth rainbow tie-dye in horizontal bands of blue, teal, violet, magenta, orange, yellow and green with soft ring shapes (average about #71756b, a neutral mean), in a 64 px RGB tile. The blurred rings repeat in the 2 x 2 thumbnail. No visible seam. The same pattern (same pattern ID, identical thumbnail) also ships in Required/Legacy Patterns and More.pat (group 'Legacy Patterns and More/Legacy Patterns/Patterns') (ps_preset_75, item 23).
use_for: colourful abstract fill behind a headline
avoid: text on top: the colours shift too much for steady contrast
restrained or corporate designs
large areas without scaling: the soft rings repeat every 64 px
cards.applies_to: a selection or layer filled with Edit > Fill (Contents: Pattern), a Pattern fill layer, a Pattern Overlay layer effect or the Pattern Stamp tool; it tiles every 64 x 64 px at 100% scale (RGB tile), so the grain's real size depends on the document's pixel dimensions: on a 300 ppi print file it looks smaller than on screen, use the Scale setting to adjust.
cards.how_to_apply: Patterns panel menu > Import Patterns... and pick <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Required/Legacy Patterns and More.pat (the harvest did not find this pattern in the panel's default list); 'Tie Dye' sits in that library (group 'Legacy Patterns'). Then use it in Edit > Fill > Pattern, Layer > New Fill Layer > Pattern, or a Pattern Overlay effect. Script: load the file into the pattern presets, then an Action Manager make of a content layer of type patternLayer addressed by name and pattern ID (this is how PGD applied it).
cards.notes: Look from PGD's thumbnail: the pattern applied by script as a fill layer at 100% scale on a 256 px square (4.0 x 4.0 tiles), shown at 100% of actual size in the thumbnail. Tile size and colour mode read from the .pat file.
